echo_forge.name: Echo Forge
echo_forge.intro: A dead forge still repeats the last blows struck upon it. The anvil seems to recognize the weapon in your hand.

choices.name: Teach the blade to listen
choices.description: Bind a Storm Echo to the equipped weapon and feed it 80 remembered combat XP.

choices.name: Quench it in your own blood
choices.description: +28% damage this expedition, -18% max HP, and gain the permanent Blood-Tempered campaign mark.

choices.name: Strip the runes for parts
choices.description: Gain Mana and Iron immediately, but the noise summons three Elites.

warden_grave.name: Warden Grave
warden_grave.intro: A forgotten Warden was buried facing the frontier, weapon planted upright as if the dead still expect an attack.

choices.name: Swear their unfinished oath
choices.description: Your largest Warband cohort inherits Oathkeeper and the army deals +16% damage this expedition.

choices.name: Take what the dead no longer need
choices.description: Gain 145 Gold and 20 Iron. Three grave-bound Elites object.

choices.name: Carry the name back to Dawnkeep
choices.description: Gain 7 Renown, 2 Atlas Insight, and immediately uncover a new rumor.

greedy_idol.name: Greedy Idol
greedy_idol.intro: The idol has no mouth, yet you can hear it appraising the weight of your purse.

choices.name: Feed it 80 Gold
choices.description: Pay 80 Gold. Gain +10% Fortune this expedition and the idol coughs back 70 Gold in old coin.

choices.name: Let it devour 220 Gold
choices.description: Pay 220 Gold for +25% damage and +16% Fortune this expedition. Gain the permanent Hunger Debt mark.

choices.name: Break the little parasite
choices.description: Steal 190 Gold from its belly. Four furious Elites arrive to collect.

moon_shrine.name: Moon Shrine
moon_shrine.intro: A crescent of pale stone reflects a moon that is not currently in the sky.

choices.name: Lay your weapon in the moonlight
choices.description: Awaken a Moonlit Echo and feed the weapon 55 Memory XP.

choices.name: Bathe in the false moonlight
choices.description: Heal 50% max HP and gain +10% crit and +18% arc chance for this expedition.

choices.name: Ask the moon to remember you
choices.description: Gain the permanent Moon Mark and +1 Atlas Insight.

beast_nest.name: Beast Nest
beast_nest.intro: Tracks circle the den in impossible layers. Something here has been watching armies march by for years.

choices.name: Approach without drawing steel
choices.description: Attempt to form the local Wild Bond immediately.

choices.name: Raid the nest
choices.description: Gain 36 Food and 65 Gold. Two alpha defenders emerge as Elites.

choices.name: Study how the pack moves
choices.description: Your largest Warband cohort gains Beastfriend and +10% army damage this expedition.

shattered_caravan.name: Shattered Caravan
shattered_caravan.intro: The wagons are fresh enough to smoke. No bodies remain, but every wheel points in a different direction.

choices.name: Follow the impossible tracks
choices.description: Your largest cohort gains Roadborn and you heal 35% max HP.

choices.name: Salvage before whoever did this returns
choices.description: Gain Wood, Stone and Gold. Immediately attract a Pursuit Hunter Pack.

choices.name: Read the blood-stained manifest
choices.description: Gain 2 Atlas Insight and reveal a new rumor elsewhere in the frontier.

time_scar.name: Time Scar
time_scar.intro: Rain falls upward inside the fracture. You see yourself arrive, leave, die and never come here at all.

choices.name: Steal seconds from your future
choices.description: +30% attack speed and +12% movement this run. Gain the permanent Time Debt mark.

choices.name: Erase one old regret
choices.description: Remove your oldest campaign mark, heal 75% max HP and gain +1 Insight.

choices.name: Show your weapon a future battle
choices.description: Feed it 160 Memory XP, but enemies become 16% faster this expedition.

black_mirror.name: Black Mirror
black_mirror.intro: Your reflection is armed differently. It smiles half a second before you do.

choices.name: Reach in and take its weapon
choices.description: Awaken Voidglass on your equipped weapon. Your max HP falls 14% for this expedition.

choices.name: Copy the other Warden's stance
choices.description: +1 projectile and +12% critical chance this expedition.

choices.name: Shatter the reflection before it escapes
choices.description: +34% damage this expedition. Four mirror-born Elites emerge from the shards.

sealed_vault.name: Sealed Vault
sealed_vault.intro: The lock has nine keyholes and no door. Something behind the stone whispers the names of your dead enemies.

choices.name: Let your weapon answer
choices.description: Awaken Gravebound, gain 45 Memory XP, 130 Gold and 8 Mana.

choices.name: Force every lock at once
choices.description: Gain 210 Gold, 24 Iron and 6 Mana. Five Vault Wardens attack.

choices.name: Copy the impossible lock into your Atlas
choices.description: Gain 4 Atlas Insight and immediately reveal another rumor.
